title: Ba Jardins ya Prosperité oyo ezali kosila
intro: Na mboka oyo epambolamaki na bozwi mingi, lisanga moko ekoli, kofanda na katikati ya bilembo ya ngolu ya bonzambe. Bomengo na bango ezalaki litatoli ya boboto ya Nkolo na bango, likabo oyo esengelaki kofula botondi mpe botosi. Nzokande, atako bilembo ya polele ya mapamboli na bango, mbongwana moko eyaki, oyo etyaki ntembe na botɔndi na bango mpo na liziba ya bozwi mpe libɔndisi na bango monene.
clues: Topambolamaki na bilanga mibale, moko na loboko ya mobali mpe mosusu na loboko ya mwasi, etondi na mbuma.
Topesamaki mitindo ya kolia uta na bilei ya Nkolo na biso mpe kozala na botondi epai na Ye mpo na mboka malamu mpe Nkolo moko ya kolimbisa.
Tokolaki na lolendo mpe tobalukaki mosika na nzela ya botondi, komikumisa mpo na bomengo mpe nguya na biso.
Tosengaki ete Nkolo na biso abakisa ntaka kati na mibembo na biso, kolakisa botyoli mpo na pete oyo Ye apesaki.
Tokebisamaki na momemi-nsango moko, kasi toboyaki nsango mpe tokobaki na bozangi bokebi na biso.
Barrage na biso monene, oyo esimbaki bomengo na biso, na nsuka ebukanaki, ememaki na mpela ya kobebisa.

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Invasion ya armée moko ya makasi
Koningana ya mabele oyo ebebisaki mpenza
Mpela ya kobebisa oyo euti na barrage oyo ebukanaki
Konyokolama na mokonzi moko ya mobulu
trial.answer: Mpela ya kobebisa oyo euti na barrage oyo ebukanaki

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Tobongwanaki na ba singes mpe ba ngulu
Tobikisamaki mpe tokendeki kofanda na mboka ya sika
Topalanganaki mpe mabele na biso ekómaki mpamba
Totongaki bokonzi ya sika, oyo ezalaki na bozwi mingi
outcome.answer: Topalanganaki mpe mabele na biso ekómaki mpamba

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
